title: Credo at OCP 2026: Micro-Emitter Optics and AI Interconnect Reliability
content: In this partner interview, Credo’s Don Barnetson explains how micro-emitter optics and the 1.6T ZeroFlap ALC deliver reliable AI cluster interconnects. The post Credo at OCP 2026: Micro-Emitter Optics and AI Interconnect Reliability appeared first on EE Times .
